title: Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) — FAP Charge Basis and Amounts Generally Billed
content:
## Charge basis figures

Every tier of the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) uses the same charge basis settings:

| Setting | Value on every tier |
|---|---|
| Amounts-generally-billed percentage of gross charges for the fiscal year | 34.6 percent |
| IRS 501(r) method used to compute amounts generally billed | look-back method, Medicare fee-for-service and private insurers |
| Charge basis of a self-pay encounter for FAP purposes | the amounts-generally-billed amount of gross charges |
| Charge basis of an insured encounter for FAP purposes | the patient responsibility posted from the payer |
| Rounding of FAP liability and charity adjustment amounts | half-up to the cent |

Tiers covered: Riverbend Presumptive Charity Care; Riverbend Full Charity Care (0-200% FPL); Riverbend 80% Charity Discount (201-250% FPL); Riverbend 60% Charity Discount (251-300% FPL); Riverbend 40% Charity Discount (301-400% FPL); Riverbend Medical Hardship Assistance (above 400% FPL).

### What the figures mean

- The amounts-generally-billed percentage (34.6 percent) is Riverbend's look-back percentage of gross charges: the amounts-generally-billed amount of a self-pay encounter is 34.6 percent of its gross charges.
- An insured encounter is not revalued at that percentage; its charge basis is the patient responsibility its payer posted.
- Hypothetical illustration: a self-pay encounter with gross charges of 1,000.00 USD has an amounts-generally-billed amount of 346.00 USD.
